import pathlib,json,hashlib,datetime
root=pathlib.Path('products/services/docs-repair/request-fulfillment')
p=root/'candidate-rejection-evidence.json'
raw=p.read_bytes()
evidence=json.loads(raw)
data={'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'verdict':'STOP_THIS_EXPERIMENT','scope':'The existing five candidates only; no further discovery or implementation','evidence_file':str(p),'evidence_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'candidate_evidence':evidence,'delivery_status':{'patch_prepared':False,'external_submission':False,'buyer_interest_verified':False,'payment_verified':False},'lesson':'Existing assignment discussions and contribution prerequisites prevent treating an apparently simple public request as available paid work. Preserve exact evidence, stop rejected experiments, and establish an accessible submission route and explicit payment terms before implementation.'}
out=root/'final-verdict.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
verified=json.loads(out.read_text())
assert verified['candidate_evidence']==evidence
print(json.dumps({'artifact':str(out),'verdict':verified['verdict'],'source_sha256':verified['evidence_sha256'],'saved_evidence_read_back':True}))

description: Close the two bounded experiments from existing evidence. Funding and revenue remain unverified; no spending, publication or new product work.
